visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with three passion fruit shells filled with yellow frozen pulp resting on a white ceramic plate. A man with long dark hair, wearing a grey t-shirt and necklace, appears at the bottom in a small cutout, holding two whole passion fruits. (2) Hands use a large spoon to scoop thick white honey yogurt into a glass bowl placed on a digital kitchen scale. The setting is a clean, bright indoor kitchen with wooden surfaces and white background elements. (3) A close-up shows hands scooping yellow passion fruit seeds and juice from a purple shell into a plastic measuring cup on the scale. The man's face appears intermittently in the bottom corner, talking with an animated expression. (4) An immersion blender with a metallic finish is used to pulse the passion fruit mixture in the plastic cup. A fine-mesh metal strainer is then held over a glass bowl while the blended juice is poured through it, leaving seeds behind. (5) Yellow liquid is poured into the bowl of yogurt and mixed with a wire whisk until smooth and pale yellow. The mixture is then poured into hollowed-out passion fruit shells. (6) A hand places a tray containing the filled shells into a large silver commercial-style freezer shelf. Later, the man holds one finished shell, takes a bite with a spoon, and reacts with wide eyes and a surprised, happy smile. (7) Heart-shaped animated overlays float around the man as he continues to eat the dessert. Close-ups show the icy, sorbet-like texture of the yellow filling being scooped from the dark purple fruit skin.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male voice introduces the recipe with a rapid speech rate and high pitch variability. An upbeat, bouncy electronic BGM with a strong rhythmic beat begins immediately. (2) A metallic scraping sound of a spoon hitting a glass bowl is heard as the narrator explains the yogurt measurements. The music remains steady and cheerful. (3) Wet, squelching sounds of fruit pulp being scooped are clearly audible. The narrator’s voice becomes more animated, emphasizing key ingredients. (4) A mechanical whirring sound of a high-speed blender pulses briefly, followed by the percussive sound of a liquid being poured and a whisk hitting the side of a bowl. (5) A sharp mechanical click and metallic rattle signal the freezer door opening and closing. The narrator’s tone shifts to excitement as he presents the 'final product'. (6) Distinct scraping and crunching sounds of a spoon digging into a frozen surface are heard. The narrator lets out an appreciative, high-arousal exclamation, followed by 'Pop' and 'Ding' sound effects that emphasize his surprised reaction.
